notes: Casino: slot machine sounds — the reels whirr and clunk as each one stops, then a jingle for a win (bigger for three of a kind) or a sad "womp".
Casino: your points only go up once the reels stop, so the result isn't spoiled.
Casino: when you leave, the chat shows how your session went (won / lost / broke even). Results in a row share one card, and clicking it joins the casino.
